question: What explanatory claim is requested regarding the locus of dissolution and the full extent of what undergoes it?
premises: Dissolution is said to occur for something.
The locus in which that dissolution takes place is unknown.
The full extent of what undergoes dissolution is also unknown.
inference: A full explanation is requested of both the locus of dissolution and all that goes to dissolution.
uncertainties: No locus or extent is specified in this verse
plain_english: And in what does it indeed go to dissolution? Tell me all of that.
